usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and webCRM receives follow-up work through “Create Activity”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Activity” in webCRM
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order becomes an activity with a date and assignee, so someone follows up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so its activity appears after a scheduled check.
